issue.title: [Bug]: aws_network_acl_rule "Missing Resource Identity After Read" on every plan after upgrading to 6.59.0
issue.body:
### Terraform and AWS Provider Version

```console
- Terraform v1.7.5
- AWS Provider v6.59.0 (works correctly on v6.58.0)
```

### Affected Resource(s) or Data Source(s)

- `aws_network_acl_rule`

### Expected Behavior

`terraform plan` refreshes existing `aws_network_acl_rule` resources without errors, as it did on v6.58.0 and earlier.

### Actual Behavior


Every `aws_network_acl_rule` in state (dozens of rules, all created with provider versions prior to resource identity support) fails the plan with:

```
│ Error: Missing Resource Identity After Read: The Terraform provider unexpectedly returned no resource identity after having no errors in the resource read. This is always a problem with the provider and should be reported to the provider developer
│
│   with module.nacl["data-private-managed"].aws_network_acl_rule.ingress["402"],
│   on .terraform/modules/nacl/modules/nacl/main.tf line 26, in resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "ingress":
│   26: resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "ingress" {
```

The refresh of each resource completes without error; the identity guard then fails at the end of the plan. The rules still exist in AWS and are unchanged — this is not the out-of-band-deletion case from #46964.


### Relevant Error/Panic Output

```console

```


### Sample Terraform Configuration

<details open>
<summary>Click to expand configuration</summary>

```hcl

```
</details>


### Steps to Reproduce

1. Have `aws_network_acl_rule` resources in state that were created with a provider version older than v6.39.0 (before `aws_network_acl_rule` gained resource identity support in #47090), so identity is null in state.
2. Upgrade the provider to v6.59.0.
3. Run `terraform plan`.
4. Every such rule errors with "Missing Resource Identity After Read".

Downgrading/pinning to v6.58.0 makes the same configuration and state plan cleanly again, with no other changes.

### Debug Logging

<details open>
<summary>Click to expand log output</summary>

```console

```
</details>


### GenAI / LLM Assisted Development

n/a

### Important Facts and References

### Timeline / Regression Window

- Plans were clean on 2026-08-12 (provider v6.58.0).
- v6.59.0 was published 2026-08-12 18:48 UTC.
- First failing plan: 2026-08-13, with no configuration or state changes in between (provider version was unpinned and floated to 6.59.0).

### Suspected Cause

v6.59.0 includes two commits to `internal/provider/sdkv2/identity_interceptor.go`, merged 2026-08-11 via #49339:

- `0e1ea67d` "Do not update Resource Identity on Read if it is not mutable"
- `c84807cb` "Removes redundant retrieval of `Identity` in `identityIsFullyNull`"

For resources whose identity is fully null in state (created before their resource type gained identity support), the interceptor now appears to skip setting identity during Read, so the post-Read identity guard fires. `aws_network_acl_rule` is an SDKv2 resource with a non-mutable identity, which matches this code path.

Likely affects other SDKv2 resources with pre-identity state as well, not just `aws_network_acl_rule`.

### Would you like to implement a fix?

No
